body:
Okay be honest — which one is you today? crying in the car, cinematically. feral about a bridge. winning, quietly. tap the one that fits and Mood hands you the Taylor song for it. then tag whoever's the other one 🤍

longlivets.com/?mode=mood&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=mood
mediaCredit: Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons
altText: Taylor Swift performing the reputation set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, in a black snake-motif costume under dark green stage lighting.
why: Sept slot 2 of 2 for Mood (mood:chip-poll), the calendar's last September chance for a feature Long Live has never once posted about. Direct-address hook, three starter chips quoted verbatim from apps/web/lib/longlive/mood-starters.ts, share hook invites a tag. Link /?mode=mood verified against packages/experience/src/deepLink.ts (MODE_VALUES includes 'mood'). Media: reputation-inglewood-2023 (a scored-era Taylor photo — deliberately NOT an unscored era like evermore/Midnights/TTPD/TLOAS, so the tile can't imply Mood returns songs it doesn't score; last used 09-19, among the least-recently-used), distinct from the IG sibling's folklore tile per L001. NOTE: the calendar planned X as text-only, but check-drafts.mjs requires credited X media (2026-09-10) — a planning bug flagged in the PR body. photoEra unset: Mood is cross-era/non-themed, and the caption claims no reputation-era relevance for the photo.

critique.rationale: September's last Mood chance, and Mood has never shipped a post — this puts the site's most distinctive feature up as a 'which one is you' poll with three real starter chips quoted verbatim from mood-starters.ts, and a share hook that invites a tag. Scored-era photo so the tile implies nothing false.
